title: Fraser Minten shines as late surge lifts the Bruins past the Rangers 3-0 in season opener
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Boston Bruins Three goals over a 75-second span helped the Bruins extend their streak to 11 consecutive wins in home openers.
New York Rangers' Igor Shesterkin makes a save on a shot by the Bruins' Fraser Minten during the second period.

AP Photo/Charles Krupa BOSTON (AP) — Fraser Minten broke a scoreless tie with just over four minutes left, followed by goals by JJ Peterka and an empty-netter by Mark Kastelic 23 seconds apart, and the Boston Bruins beat the New York Rangers 3-0 on Tuesday night in the season opener for both teams.
